newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bompreco started as buy. [CORRECTED 00:25 GMT 19/11]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bompreco started as buy. [CORRECTED 00:25 GMT 19/11]

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Monday it had initiated coverage of Brazilian supermarket chain Bompreco with a buy recommendation.
-- Analyst Thomas Mobille wrote that the company had strong growth potential and a "management premium" from its likely joint venture with Dutch retail chain Kokinklijke Ahold NV.
-- Mobille also projected the group would record net income of between 18 million and 18.5 million reais in the first nine months of 1996, 26.9 million reais for all of 1996 and 40.9 million in 1997.
-- He estimated Bompreco's shares would trade on an estimated 1997 price/earnings ratio of more than 14 times in the next year. The current ratio is 10. (Corrects ratio)
